caseName: Decker v. Northwest Environmental Defense Center
caseNameFull: Decker, Oregon State Forester v. Northwest Environmental Defense Center and Georgia-Pacific West, Inc. v. Northwest Environmental Defense Center

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, 567 U. S. 933.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for divided argument granted.

Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
